root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward oneness: being one, unique, unified, or solitary.
root_idea.development: The hamzated branch is treated as developing from و-ح-د, with meanings extending from numerical or absolute oneness to unification, divine unity, and being alone or apart.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The feminine form إِحْدَى has a distinct Quranic form group and distinct feminine usage.
أَحَدٌ is a distinct Quranic nominal form with affirmative, negative, and divine-unicity usages.

senses.definition: One, one of a pair or group; the feminine form used to identify a single member or alternative.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in feminine affirmative constructions, especially with a dual or a specified group; Quranic usage includes “one of the two” and “one of a set.”

senses.definition: One; one member of a specified group or pair.
senses.usage_conditions: In affirmative constructions, it commonly appears as a prefixed or possessive noun, as in “one of them,” “one of you,” or “one of the two.”

Used especially in negative constructions, where it can range over persons collectively or individually and can correspond to different genders or numbers. A reported variant Quran reading also uses it for “anything.”

senses.definition: The One: unique, indivisible, and without a counterpart.
senses.usage_conditions: Used absolutely as an epithet of God, rather than as an ordinary affirmative noun for a person or object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One as the first number, including its use in compound numerals such as eleven and twenty-one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the compound eleven, أَحَدٌ is masculine and إِحْدَى is feminine; in other compound numerals it may alternate with وَاحِدٌ according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one; to unite or unify.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II verb, synonymous in this branch with making things one or united.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare or profess God to be one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction with God as object and meaning profession of divine unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a number increase by one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression “make ten become eleven.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become alone, apart from others, or solitary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage meaning to remain by oneself or separate from others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Not to know, understand, perceive, or become aware of a thing or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage attributed to Yemen, especially in the expression مَا اسْتَأْحَدَ بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great, grievous, or terrible event; a calamity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic intensive expression for an event of exceptional severity or magnitude.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unique among the unique; unequalled or incomparable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An expression of the highest praise, especially for an intelligent or distinguished being.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of a set, in an exceptional independent use of إِحْدَى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the reported expression إِحْدَى مِنْ سَبْعٍ, where إِحْدَى is neither part of a compound numeral nor a prefixed noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Born of noble or generous ancestry; a person of distinguished lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression said of a man and also applied to a camel; related forms occur in expressions about managing a difficult affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The unity or oneness of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived abstract noun denoting divine unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One by one; singly and successively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used repetitively in expressions describing people arriving or acting individually.
Used in questions such as “Has anyone seen this?”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sunday, the first day of the week.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use for the day; the historical reckoning of the week is noted as varying among authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reports transmitted by some lexicologists or transmitters, but not by so many that collusion on falsehood is considered impossible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term contrasted with مُتَوَاتِرٌ, reports transmitted by a larger number.
